meta.name: elevenlabs-sound-effects
meta.description: Generate AI sound effects from text descriptions with ElevenLabs via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: text-to-sound-effect, custom duration, royalty-free audio. Use for: video production, game audio, podcasts, films, presentations, social media. Triggers: sound effects, sfx, sound generation, ai sound effects, generate sound, foley, audio effects, sound design, text to sound, elevenlabs sound, eleven labs sfx, ambient sound, cinematic sound, game sound effects

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成音效，用于视频、游戏等创作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速为项目添加自定义音效
copy.tagline_en: Generate sound effects from text for videos, games, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need custom sound effects for your creative projects

howto.what: Claude 可以根据文字描述生成 AI 音效，支持自定义时长和 prompt 忠实度，输出免版税音频。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成音效、SFX、环境声等，或提及“sound effects”、“sfx”、“foley”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 生成一段雷声隆隆的音效。
say.note: Claude 会调用 ElevenLabs 生成对应音效。

say.text: 做一个 10 秒的黑暗氛围 drone 音效。
say.note: 指定时长，Claude 会生成 10 秒音效。

say.text: 生成一个 0.5 秒的 UI 按钮点击声。
say.note: 短时长音效，适合 UI 反馈。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate AI sound effects from text descriptions, with options for custom duration and prompt influence, outputting royalty-free audio.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for sound effects, SFX, ambient sounds, or mentions keywords like 'sound effects', 'sfx', 'foley', etc.

say_en.text: Generate a sound effect of thunder rumbling.
say_en.note: Claude will call ElevenLabs to generate the sound.
Short duration suitable for UI feedback.
